base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl build-essential pkg-config ca-certificates
setup_runtime_commands: /opt/conda/bin/conda create -n arrow-cpp -y python=3.11 cmake>=3.16 ninja c-compiler cxx-compiler pkg-config make
/opt/conda/bin/conda install -n arrow-cpp -y -c conda-forge benchmark>=1.6.0 boost-cpp>=1.68.0 gtest>=1.10.0 gflags glog snappy lz4-c zlib brotli thrift-cpp>=0.11.0 rapidjson re2 zstd openssl
detected_test_command: cd /workspace/cpp && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/opt/conda/envs/arrow-cpp -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DARROW_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DARROW_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON -DPARQUET_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON && cmake --build build -j$(nproc) --target parquet-benchmarks
runtime_smoke_command: source /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate arrow-cpp && cmake --version && ninja --version

runtime_profile.notes: Conda environment 'arrow-cpp' contains all C++ dependencies for building and running Apache Arrow Parquet benchmarks. The environment uses conda-forge channel for C++ packages.

notes: Base image ubuntu:22.04 provides git and curl by default in minimal installations, but they are explicitly included in system_packages for clarity. The conda environment 'arrow-cpp' is created with all necessary C++ toolchain and library dependencies for the Apache Arrow Parquet benchmark project. CMake 3.16+ and ninja are included as required by the build system.
